# Auto Body Specialists of Bloomington

> Collision & auto body repair based in Bloomington, Indiana. Accident damage, dents, frame work and paint, fixed by a Bloomington shop customers call kind, courteous and true to the ready date they give you.

## Services
- Collision repair: After an accident, we take the car in, repair the damage and get it back to you looking right.
- Frame straightening: Our own frame rack and pulling setup, right here in the shop, for damage that goes deeper than the panels.
- Door & panel repair: Dented, creased or crushed doors and panels, repaired so the damage disappears.
- Paint & refinish: Repaired panels painted to match the rest of the car, with a clean, glossy finish.
- Insurance claim repairs: Many customers come to us after a claim. We work with your insurance company and handle the paperwork with you.
- Estimates: Call or send photos of the damage online. Customers say our estimates are accurate and the work stays on them.

## About
Auto Body Specialists of Bloomington is the locally owned collision shop at 116 S Adams St, west of downtown. Look for the carved limestone sign with the blue script and steel swoosh out front, lit up at night. Inside is a working body shop with its own frame-straightening rack, so cars with deeper damage are repaired here start to finish, from minor dents to a tree falling on the car. Customers mention Joe and Ryan by name for making scheduling, estimates and insurance easy. With 247 Google reviews at 4.9 stars and 5.0 on Yelp, people keep saying the same things: honest, ready when promised, and the car comes back looking better than before, often cleaned up inside with the windows washed.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
  A: Yes. Many of our customers come to us after an insurance claim, and we work with your insurer and help with the paperwork. Call (812) 323-1500 with your claim details.
- Q: How long will my repair take?
  A: It depends on the damage and parts. We stay busy, so call ahead. We'll give you a ready date, and customers say we keep it.
- Q: Can you fix frame damage?
  A: Yes. We have a frame-straightening rack in the shop, so frame work is done in-house as part of the collision repair.
- Q: Will you repair a part or replace it?
  A: When a repair will do the job right, we repair it. Customers have told us they appreciated that we fixed a bumper rather than replacing it.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 116 S Adams St, Bloomington, IN 47404, just west of downtown. Look for the limestone sign out front.
